profile.headline: Principal AI Solutions Engineer at Twenty-Six Defense
profile.summary:
I'm a forward deployed engineer. I build the guardrails that let AI ship into production environments - the approval gates, the source tracing, and the deterministic checks that decide what an agent is actually allowed to do.

That's the hard part of this work. Getting a model to produce something impressive is a weekend. Getting it to run inside a real business, touching real customer data and real revenue, without anyone losing trust in it - that's the job. Every system I ship has a human sign-off in it somewhere, and a way to prove who approved what.

What that looks like in practice:

• SiteFoundry - 40 specialist agents can propose anything; deterministic code decides what ships, and no live URL is allowed to disappear on the way
• ScribeFlow - governed content system where every claim traces to an approved source and every model cost is metered
• Conversational AI agents for quoting, service requests, and lead intake - 70% reduction in handling time
• Integration pipelines across CRMs, quoting systems, and databases, tripling operational throughput

I spent seven years in front of clients before I ever shipped production code, so scoping a messy problem in a room full of non-engineers is the easy part. Then I go build it: full-stack applications, agentic AI, deep API integration work, CI/CD - and I stay on it after go-live.

I hold an active TS/SCI clearance and have served in the Arizona Army National Guard since 2011, which is where I learned to be useful when the plan changes and you deliver anyway.

I'm looking for forward deployed and solutions engineering roles at companies putting AI in front of real users - commercial or defense. Outside of work: lifelong Star Trek fan, trumpet player, and always a side project running.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
positions.description:
I own technology and delivery at a Gilbert, AZ digital agency that builds the web, SEO, and automation infrastructure small businesses run on.
What I run:
• Website engineering: custom Next.js builds structured for SEO and AI citation. One law-firm rebuild shipped 35 AI-optimized pages, 11 Phoenix-metro location pages, 43 FAQ pages, and zero JSON-LD errors.
• CRM and workflow automation: GoHighLevel pipelines, booking, review requests, and lead routing, tested before anything touches a live customer.
• Local SEO systems: Google Business Profile optimization, citations, and reporting.
• Internal products: SDM Access (client business hub) and RevaMark (visual website feedback), plus agent-assisted site builds with deterministic gates.
Same approach as everything else I do: sit with the owner, find where the process breaks, ship something that holds up in production, and stay on it after launch.

positions.description:
Podcast production studio based in Mesa, AZ.

I run it end to end and built the product side myself: the Next.js 15 site at boldmedia.cc, the packaged production tiers, and the SEO and content pipeline behind it.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Interview podcast I founded, host, and produce.

I own the full stack behind it: recording and post-production workflow, publishing, and the site.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer & AI Engineer (Forward Deployed)
positions.description:
I operate as the technical end of the customer relationship: scoping problems with agents and operators, building the system, deploying it into their workflow, and owning it after go-live. Full-stack development, applied ML, agentic AI, and deep API integration work — all judged on whether the business outcome actually moved.

Highlights:

• Built and deployed conversational AI agents to automate quoting, service requests, and lead intake — cutting handling time by 70%.
• Engineered end-to-end automation pipelines linking CRMs, quoting tools, and databases, tripling operational efficiency.
• Designed modular, error-resilient workflows with advanced API integrations and dynamic data mapping.
• Led CI/CD deployment and version-controlled automation, improving speed, stability, and maintainability.
• Partnered with cross-functional teams to design AI-first architecture that delivered measurable ROI.

Domain & customer-side experience:

I also work as a licensed Agent Producer, so I know the job of the people I build for — which is why the systems I deploy get used instead of abandoned.

• Increased lead conversions by 20% and reduced response times by 30% with AI-powered tools and chatbots.
• Hosted an insurance and financial podcast to build authority and audience engagement.
• Conducted detailed policy reviews, uncovering coverage gaps and strengthening client retention.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Developer · AI Engineer · Conversational AI

positions.title: Founder (Forward Deployed Consultant)
positions.description:
Veteran-owned consultancy doing forward-deployed style work for small businesses before I had a name for it.

I embed directly with each owner, learn their actual workflow, and build the system around how they really operate: dashboards, portals, booking systems, automated lead intake, customer support, and review generation.

No off-the-shelf templates. Every build starts with sitting down with the business to find where the process actually breaks, then shipping something that survives contact with how they really work day to day.

I stay accountable for the outcome after launch, not just the handoff. If it doesn't hold up in production, that's on me.

positions.title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
positions.description:
Fifteen years of service with an active TS/SCI clearance, most of it doing forward deployed work before the tech industry had a name for it: high trust, high ambiguity, execution at the customer's site instead of from behind a desk.

Led small teams under time pressure and incomplete information, coordinated across units and civilian agencies, and operated in environments where the plan changes and you deliver anyway.

projects.title: Kinetic Enterprise - Agency Operations Platform
projects.description:
Internal command center where the agency itself runs: CRM, billing, SEO intelligence, and a live AI agent control plane in one operator-only portal.

Built for daily operator use rather than as a client deliverable, with a public feedback and roadmap loop wired in so the people using it could shape what got built next.

Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Vercel.

projects.title: MyFusion Social - Governed Multi-Tenant Social Publishing Platform
projects.description:
Social publishing tool with a create, review, publish workflow and a human approval step before anything goes live.

Handles multi-account OAuth connections to Facebook Pages and other channels, organization-scoped sign-in for multi-client use, and Google Places enrichment. Built on the Zernio publishing API.

Stack: Next.js, Clerk, Facebook Graph API, Google Cloud.
